name: Leshy
source: Pathfinder NPC Core, Leshy (pg. 169), via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/MonsterTemplates.aspx?ID=50
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder NPC Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: Replaces its ancestry trait with leshy and humanoid with plant (or fungus); adds Fey, low-light vision, size Small, Verdant Burst.

abilities.name: Verdant Burst
abilities.description: When {name} dies, a burst of primal energy explodes from their body, restoring {steps|1d4|1=1d8|2=2d8|4=3d8|6=4d8|8=5d8|10=6d8|12=7d8|14=8d8|16=9d8|18=10d8|20=11d8} Hit Points to each plant creature in a 30-foot emanation. This area is filled with plants, becoming difficult terrain. If the terrain is not a viable environment for these plants, they wither after 24 hours.

abilities.name: Verdant Burst
abilities.description: When {name} dies, a burst of primal energy explodes from their body, restoring {steps|1d4|1=1d8|2=2d8|4=3d8|6=4d8|8=5d8|10=6d8|12=7d8|14=8d8|16=9d8|18=10d8|20=11d8} Hit Points to each fungus creature in a 30-foot emanation. This area is filled with fungi, becoming difficult terrain. If the terrain is not a viable environment for these fungi, they wither after 24 hours.
